## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

 However, automated text-reuse analysis by DharmaNexus identifies recurring stock passages shared with several other Apadāna texts centered on ascetic gift-giving [DharmaNexus]. In particular, segments §6.1–8.1 share close formulaic verses with the *Paṇṇadāyakattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 260, §5.1–7.1) and the *Daṇḍadāyakattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 357, §4.1–6.1), as well as a similar passage in the *Bhikkhadāyakattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 103, §6.3–8.1) [DharmaNexus]. In addition, segments §4.1–4.4 are quoted or shared with the first volume of the *Theragāthā-aṭṭhakathā* (§1353–1355) [DharmaNexus]. DharmaNexus also indicates low-scoring machine alignments with sections of the Tibetan *Buddha-avataṃsaka-sūtra*, though these represent automatic matches rather than historical parallels [DharmaNexus].

*No discussion of this text was found in the reference-literature corpus; the overview relies on catalog and DharmaNexus data.*
